# React Bits components used by Creative AI

These files are the original React component implementations and companion styles sourced from the public React Bits repository:

- Source repository: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits
- Component documentation: https://reactbits.dev
- Components included: Side Rays, Antigravity, Magic Bento, Gradient Text, Spotlight Card, Logo Loop, Animated Content, Pill Nav, Chroma Grid, and Count Up.

The component source files are kept separate from Creative AI's existing static HTML/CSS/vanilla-JavaScript application. The Vite entry at `scripts/components-entry.jsx` mounts them as a focused React island on the homepage. Do not edit the vendored source to imitate a different component; tune props and the Creative AI integration stylesheet instead.

Upstream component files are preserved as sourced. Refer to the upstream repository for the applicable license and attribution terms before redistributing these files outside this project.
